_readme: SEED ONLY — extracted from the spec's Appendix A, which stays the place a human reads WHY.
Applied once, when the template table is empty. After that the datastore is the truth and
our platform console edits it at runtime: no rebuild, no redeploy, no restart. Exactly the
pattern the roles seed already proved on the cluster.
Re-applying on every boot would silently undo an operator's edits — a console that appears
to work while its changes vanish overnight is worse than no console.
`variables` is derived, not typed by hand: Meta numbers variables and refuses a gap, and
counting them caught two templates that opened at {{2}} and would have been rejected at
submission with a message blaming the wording.
_variable_examples_why: META REQUIRES AN EXAMPLE FOR EVERY PLACEHOLDER at creation, and refuses the template
without one. This library had none: `library.py` read `template.get('examples') or []`
and every one of the 66 rows sent an empty list, so every submission was refused and
the shop sat «connected» in green with every send «under review» for ever.
The real values existed — in deploy/seed/templates.json, which only the manual script
reads. They are here now, in the file the live path actually submits, keyed by the
variable NUMBER because that is how Meta fills them. ci/check_meta_rules.py checks
this file too, not only the generated one.

_: THE RATING APP'S OWN TEMPLATE (rating-app-feature.md, phase 3) — the SAME slot
svc_visit_confirmation fills, never sent alongside it (scheduling.py picks one of the
two per visit, based on whether this shop owns feature.rating and has it enabled).
{{3}} IS COMPUTED SERVER-SIDE, NEVER A TEMPLATE-LEVEL CONDITION (fills: rating_cta) —
same discipline as {{invite}}: WhatsApp refuses an empty variable, so a shop with no
participation points configured gets a full neutral sentence here, never a blank or a
flow_button references the per-shop Flow clone by its stable flow_name (flows.py,
RATING_FLOW_NAME = "rating_flow") — not by flow_id, which differs per shop and only
exists after that shop's clone is provisioned.

templates.name: per_weekly_digest_masculine
templates.label: تقرير الأسبوع للمالك
templates.body: أهلاً، هذا ملخّص أسبوعك في {{1}}: {{2}}.
templates.model_why: تقرير المحل عن نفسه إلى صاحبه، وكل قطاع له أسبوع. الزر يفتح نفس التقرير كشاشة تفاعلية منظّمة (rating-app-feature.md phase 6b) — النص يبقى كملخّص سريع، بلا أي اعتماد بينهما: شحن الفلو فشل أو لم يُوفَّر بعد لهذا المحل، والنص وحده يكفي. {{1}} هو اسم المحل (لا عميل بهذا القالب إطلاقاً — fixed 2026-09-08: كان يسقط لاسم عميل عشوائي)، و{{2}} النص المُركَّب فعليًا لهذا الأسبوع (core/digest.py::build) — سطر الزيارات وما بعده، لا اسم خدمة مفردة كما كان مكتوبًا هنا سابقًا؛ ذلك الوصف لم يعد يطابق ما يبنيه digest.py منذ صار تقريرًا متعدد الأسطر.
examples: زياراتك: 12، عملاء جدد: 3، الأكثر طلبًا: غسيل خارجي
